@@U04704@@
(From inside him.)

@@U04705@@
The sight is great, but earth’s too gloomy, it moves us with dread, we tremble in fear. Good father, let us free from here.

@@U04707@@
Mount, rise up, to higher circles, grow invisibly as God’s presence makes you ever stronger with eternal purity. This it is that feeds the spirit, this that fills ethereal space, love’s eternal revelation, love that leads to pure salvation.

@@U04709@@
(Circling around the highest peaks.)

@@U04710@@
Join hands and sing! Join hands in a ring! Dance and sing your deepest feelings! Divinely schooled, be certain to see, Him that you love in eternity!

@@U04712@@
(Hovering in the upper atmosphere, bearing 浮士德’ immortal part.)

@@U04713@@
Saved now, saved from Satan’s power, this great soul rejoices. Who strives, and never ceases striving, is worthy of redemption. And if the love that reigns on high has shown him gracious favor, then angel hosts will sing his praise, and give him joyous welcome.
translation:
@@U04704@@
（来自他的内心。）

@@U04705@@
景色很美，但地球太阴暗，它让我们心惊胆战，我们害怕得发抖。好父亲，让我们离开这里吧。

@@U04707@@
登上，上升，进入更高的圈子，在无形中成长，因为上帝的存在使你变得更加强大和永恒的纯洁。正是它滋养了精神，它充满了空灵的空间，爱的永恒启示，爱带来了纯粹的救赎。

@@U04709@@
（绕着最高峰转一圈。）

@@U04710@@
携起手来，歌唱吧！手牵着手，围成一圈！跳舞、唱出你最深的感受！受过神圣的教育，一定要见到你在永恒中所爱的他！

@@U04712@@
（悬浮在高层大气，承载着浮士德的不朽部分。）

@@U04713@@
现在，这个伟大的灵魂已经得救了，脱离了撒旦的权势，他感到很高兴。努力奋斗、永不停止奋斗的人，是值得救赎的。如果高处的爱向他施恩，那么天使们就会歌颂他，并以欢乐的方式欢迎他。
